observed_title: An Extension of the Bianchi-Egnell Stability Estimate to Bakry, Gentil, and Ledoux's Generalization of the Sobolev Inequality to Continuous Dimensions
version: arXiv1512.06121v2,2Sep2020 side label; front manuscript November5,2015. Official revision comments verified separately 2026-10-06; v1 not full read in this card.

read_ranges.scope: All sections1–8 including Taylor remainder, compact Hessian proof/Green functions/trace power, nullspace/ODE argument, global concentration compactness and delayed local compactness proof, references; all nonempty text sequentially read.

topic_relevance.basis: Weighted continuous-dimensional Sobolev stability, fixed-parameter H1 distance to complex amplitude/dilation/x-translation manifold; cited primary dependency of GN lift but narrower revised parameter range and unresolved proof errors.

official_sourcecheck.read_scope: Official metadata/revision notice only; local v2 full PDF read independently
official_sourcecheck.change: Original v1 claimed m>0. Author says only able to prove m≥1 with m+n>2, and only changes in Th1.4 and Th1.5. This is a scope revision, not a withdrawal notice or proof certification.
official_sourcecheck.v1_status: No silent substitution. Older GN reference cites1512.06121v1; its broader m>0 scope cannot be certified from v2.

definitions.name: Weighted cylindrical Hilbert space
definitions.statement: m≥1,n≥1 integer,m+n>2, dΛ=ω_mρ^(m−1)dρ dx. Complex φ on R+×R^n, finite distributional-gradient norm, each positive superlevel has finite Λ measure. The x variables are unrestricted, so translation tangents belong to this space. p*=2(m+n)/(m+n−2),γ=(m+n−2)/2.

definitions.name: Optimizer manifold and distance
definitions.statement: F_(t,x0)=k0t^γ(1+t²ρ²+t²|x−x0|²)^(-γ),k0 gives H1norm1; M={zF_(t,x0):z∈C,t>0,x0∈R^n}; distance is inf H1 gradient norm over M.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem1.5 revised BE stability
assumptions: m≥1,n≥1 integer,m+n>2; weighted cylindrical Ḣ1_C as defined
Distance to complete complex amplitude/positive dilation/x-translation optimizer manifold
theorem_cards.statement: Source reports C_m,n²||φ||_Ḣ1²−||φ||_(p*)²≥α(m,n)dist_Ḣ1(φ,M)², α>0 depending only on fixed m,n. Source states quadratic exponent cannot be replaced by β<2 after homogeneous normalization.
proof_steps: Explicit norm Taylor expansion and duality-map continuity produce local quadratic estimate plus higher-order remainder
Compactness of Hessian correction via log radial coordinates, positive operator comparison and finite trace of large even powers
Source identifies Hessian kernel and obtains a positive spectral gap after nearest-manifold orthogonality
Global contradiction uses scaled/rearranged annular mass, pqr nonvanishing, x translations, local compactness and Brezis–Lieb decomposition
gaps: Th3.5/3.7 and Lem5.2 print a 3-dimensional Hessian nullspace despite n x-translation parameters. Translation tangent check below refutes that subclaim on the stated full space; source spectral-gap proof cannot be called as a complete certificate. This does not itself refute Th1.5.

Concentration proof7.8 invokes smaller radial dimension m/2, which is <1 if1≤m<2 and may make total dimension≤2 for n=1; those calls are outside the revised theorem as stated. n−δ call also is noninteger though Th1.4 states n integer. A separate double-radial theorem/argument is needed.
Local compactness estimates8.2/8.3 choose the wrong endpoint constant; locally repairable by minimum weight, but do not copy exact constants.
No explicit optimal global α, dimension-uniform constants, or m<1 stability certified.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem2.1 norm Taylor remainder
assumptions: ε∈[−1,1], complex Lp treated as real direct sum
theorem_cards.statement: Square Lp norm has quadratic expansion with operator LRe⊕LIm and remainder bounded by κ_p|ε|^βp; βp=3 forp≥4 and1+p/2 for2<p≤4, κ_p finite explicit parameter-dependent source formula.
proof_steps: Integral Taylor remainder is double integral of second-derivative difference
Expand into three scalar integrals and bound by duality-map differences
Apply Carlen–Frank–Lieb cited Hölder continuity Dp(g)=||g||_p^(1−p)|g|^(p−2)g and Hölder/triangle inequality, then integrate
gaps: Primary external duality-map lemma[7] not full read here; no unrestricted p=2/infinite-p endpoint or uniform κp extension.
The LRe/LIm form and normalizations must be used consistently; source3.12 claims ||ψ||_(p*)≤C/2 where elementary Sobolev only gives ≤C, so its downstream explicit remainder constants are unverified.

theorem_cards.label: Theorems3.5,3.7 / Lemma5.2 nullspace
assumptions: St=A^-1 L_(C^-1 F,p*) on entire complex weighted cylindrical Ḣ1
At F centered at x0=0; A=−∂ρ²−(m−1)ρ^-1∂ρ−Δx
theorem_cards.statement: Source says ker(C²I−St) is spanned only by (F,0),(∂tF,0),(0,F).
proof_steps: Source5.1 derives positivity and these three tangent modes from constant amplitude/dilation/phase curves
Source5.2 attempts to force angular independence by replacing A by lower operator Ahat
Source5.4 infers positivity of X+Y+Z from positivity of X on the radial subspace orthogonal to F; this does not control nonradial angular sectors
gaps: Missing translations: ∂x_jF is real, nonzero, finite energy, odd in x_j, hence independent of all listed radial-real and imaginary F modes. By differentiating AF=C^-p* F^(p*−1), LRe(∂x_jF)=C² A(∂x_jF), so it is also in the kernel.

Correcting kernel requires full tangent space (n+3 real directions) and proof of no further modes. Nearest-manifold optimization should give orthogonality to translations too, but those modes cannot simply be omitted.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem3.6 compact selfadjoint Hessian correction
assumptions: Fixed valid m,n and same Hilbert/measure/operator definitions
Proper positive selfadjoint realizations and domains
theorem_cards.statement: Source asserts St compact selfadjoint, scale parameter t gives unitarily equivalent spectrum.
proof_steps: Rank-one real correction plus positive imaginary multiplication; selfadjointness via energy pairing
Use A^1/2 energy isometry, compare positive sandwich with Ahat whose spectrum separates in log-coordinate/Fourier/Jacobi/spherical modes
Kernel of sufficiently large even power has finite trace, summing radial and spherical eigenvalue multiplicities; source threshold d>(n+1)/2
Log radial coordinate turns scale t into translation in u
gaps: Green-function normalization, operator domains, series and trace exchanges not independently certified; only source method distilled.

Generalized Young source uses linear-map rank conditions with all exponent2; actual cycle rows have d−1 rank and d≥2. This is a specialized multilinear integral bound, not arbitrary mixed-norm permutation.
Compactness alone gives no positive gap until complete kernel and orthogonality established.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem7.1 concentration compactness
theorem_cards.statement: Source states existence of dilations σj and x translations xj such that a subsequence converges strongly in weighted Ḣ1_C to normalized optimizer.
proof_steps: Normalize half of rearranged Lp* mass in unit ball via continuous dilation; dominated convergence uses one integrable ceiling on compact scale interval
Rule out split annular mass by uniform convexity and χ1²+χ2²=1 energy localization
Two angular cutoffs and smaller dimension Sobolev bound yield pqr nonvanishing; translated local-mass sequence has nonzero weak limit
Away-axis local compactness gives a.e. subsequence, Brezis–Lieb norm decomposition and strict concavity rule out residual mass; Hilbert weak+norm then strong
gaps: Smaller dimension calls in7.8 not within all revised stated domains; no uniform/noninteger Cartesian dimension extension certified.

Theorem7.3 proof says WLOG φj≥0; modulus replacement preserves Lp* but is not a phase-invariant strong convergence argument for the original complex sequence. Need explicit phase/subsequence restoration, not treating |φj| as identical to φj.
External rearrangement contraction and Brezis–Lieb theorem prerequisites are cited methods; not separately reproduced globally.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem1.6 / section8 local compactness
assumptions: K has stated cone property, finite weighted measure; 0<ρ1<ρ<ρ2<∞
Bounded sequence in weighted Ḣ1_C; U open subset of K
Source claims p<max(p*,2(n+1)/(n−1)); n=1 exponent interpreted via two-dimensional Sobolev local result, not literal division0
theorem_cards.statement: Source asserts a subsequence converges strongly in Lp(U,dΛ) in the stated subcritical range.
proof_steps: Away from axis weight is bounded above and below, so weighted/unweighted Lq and gradients are equivalent
Control local unweighted H1 then apply ordinary local Rellich–Kondrachov
Use bounded Lp* and interpolation to extend strong convergence below p* when appropriate
gaps: 8.2 and8.3 use ρ2 in upper norm bound despite preceding correct sandwich requiring ρ1 for m≥1. Replace by minimum weight factor ω_m^-1/q ρ1^(-(m−1)/q).
Cone/finite-volume hypotheses and unbounded-domain compactness require the precise local classical theorem; no global finite-volume compactness extension is inferred.

constant_dependence.scope: C_m,n and existentialα(m,n), local spectral gap/remainder thresholds fixed parameter. Quadratic H1-distance power; no numerical optimalα certified.
constant_dependence.weighted_norm_repair: For m≥1, lower unweighted bound usesρ2, upper usesρ1. On compact away-axis region use min/max weight; no dimension-free equivalence.
constant_dependence.mixed_norm: Generalized Young rank conditions only for source trace integral; DCT for dilations only after common Lp* ceiling and compact positive scale interval. These do not justify arbitrary limit/norm exchanges.

endpoint_limits.source_revision: v2 restricts m≥1; original v1 m>0 is explicitly superseded. m+n>2 is needed for p* even though mainTh1.5 abbreviated assumptions.
endpoint_limits.GN_transfer: m=4t/(t−1)−2n≥1 is equivalent to1<t≤(2n+1)/(2n−3) for n≥2. n2 gives t≤5. This is revised dependency compatibility only, not independent GN certification; main source proof gaps remain.
endpoint_limits.not_established: m<1, m+n=2, dimension-uniformα, arbitrary metric/space or maximal-cube stability.

reusable_methods.method: Find full symmetry tangent kernel before spectral stability
reusable_methods.transfer: Include amplitude,dilation,phase,all allowed translations; establish orthogonality to each direction and no additional null modes.

reusable_methods.method: Compact positive sandwich via finite trace power
reusable_methods.transfer: Requires selfadjoint domains, domination, series convergence, and specialized multilinear rank conditions.

reusable_methods.method: Weak nonvanishing plus mass splitting to strong convergence
reusable_methods.transfer: Need admissible normalization, local compactness, Brezis–Lieb and strict concavity in actual weighted space.

checked_derivation.statement: Take m=n=2,N4,p*=4,F=k/(1+ρ²+|x|²). g=∂x1F=−2kx1/(1+ρ²+|x|²)². Finite energy, odd x1, hence orthogonal to F and outside span{F,∂tF,iF}. Differentiating AF=C^-4F³ gives Ag=3C^-4F²g. Odd integral in LRe rank-one term vanishes, so LRe g=3C^-2F²g=C²Ag and (C²I−A^-1LRe)g=0. This refutes the claimed 3-mode kernel, not full BE inequality.

m2,ρ1=1,ρ2=2: choose nonzero smooth φ compactly supported where1<ρ<3/2. Then ||∇φ||²_weighted≤(3/2)ω2||∇φ||²_unweighted, while printed8.2 would force ||∇φ||²_unweighted≤(2ω2)^-1||∇φ||²_weighted≤3/4||∇φ||²_unweighted. Impossible. Correctupperfactorusesρ1.
